actions.name: ping
actions.summary: Check that the bridge is alive and whether the given token is valid. No token required.

actions.name: pair
actions.summary: Request a token. MarginNote shows an Allow/Deny alert; the token is returned only if the user taps Allow.

client.desc: Human-readable client name shown in the alert, e.g. "Claude Code".

actions.name: auth.clients
actions.summary: List paired clients (token hints only).

actions.name: auth.revoke
actions.summary: Revoke the calling token (default) or every token.

all.desc: Revoke every paired client, not only the caller.

actions.name: capabilities
actions.summary: Self-description: every action with its parameters, so agents can discover the API at runtime.
actions.returns: { bridgeVersion, protocol, actions: [{ name, group, summary, write, params, returns }] }

actions.name: bridge.log
actions.summary: Recent requests handled by the bridge (newest last).
actions.returns: [{ at, id, action, client, ok, code, ms }]

actions.name: context.get
actions.summary: What the user is looking at: open notebook, focused and selected notes, current document and page, text selection.
actions.returns: { studyMode, notebook, focusNote, selectedNotes, document, page, selectionText }

actions.name: ui.openNotebook
actions.summary: Open a notebook (and optionally a document) in the current window.

docMd5.desc: Document to open alongside the notebook.

actions.name: ui.focusNote
actions.summary: Scroll to and highlight a note in the mind map, the document, or the floating mind map. isFocusNote tells whether MarginNote also made it the focus note (usually it does not; selection stays with the user).

actions.name: ui.hud
actions.summary: Show a short toast message inside MarginNote.

actions.name: ui.queryCommand
actions.summary: Check whether a built-in MarginNote command is available right now (see docs/COMMANDS.md).

actions.name: ui.command
actions.summary: Run any built-in MarginNote command (menu item / shortcut) in the current window, e.g. ZoomToFit, ViewExpandAll, ToggleMindMap. Card commands act on the card the user has selected; some commands open dialogs that need the user.

actions.name: ui.undo
actions.summary: Undo the last change in MarginNote (every bridge write is one undo step named "Agent: <action>").

actions.name: ui.redo
actions.summary: Redo the last undone change.

actions.name: notebook.list
actions.summary: List all study sets / notebooks.
actions.returns: [{ id, title, type, lastVisit, documentCount, url }]

actions.name: notebook.get
actions.summary: Notebook details with its documents and root notes.

actions.name: notebook.rename
actions.summary: Rename a notebook.

actions.name: document.list
actions.summary: List documents (PDF/EPUB…), optionally only those attached to one notebook.

actions.name: document.get
actions.summary: Document details including its table of contents.

actions.name: document.pageText
actions.summary: Extract the text of one page of a document (needs a text layer; scanned pages return little or nothing).

raw.desc: Also return the raw native structure (for debugging).

actions.name: notebook.backup
actions.summary: Export a full copy of a notebook into MarginNote's own storage (Documents/AgentBridgeBackups). Take one before large edits.

actions.name: notebook.backups
actions.summary: List backups created by notebook.backup.

actions.name: notebook.restoreBackup
actions.summary: Import a backup made by notebook.backup back into MarginNote (MarginNote decides whether it merges or adds a copy).

actions.name: note.get
actions.summary: Full details of one note: title, excerpt, comments, tags, parent/children, source page, dates.

actions.name: note.batchGet
actions.summary: Details of several notes at once. Missing ids are reported instead of failing.

actions.name: note.tree
actions.summary: A subtree (from a note) or a whole mind map (from a notebook) as JSON, Markdown or an indented outline.

noteId.desc: Root of the subtree. Give noteId or notebookId.

notebookId.desc: Dump every root of this notebook.

depth.desc: Levels below the root to include (max 50).

headingLevels.desc: markdown: levels rendered as # headings before switching to bullets.

includeComments.desc: markdown: include text comments as quotes.

actions.name: note.search
actions.summary: Search notes by text or regex in titles, excerpts and comments, in one notebook or all notebooks.
actions.returns: { results: [{ ...noteSummary, notebookId, matchedIn, path }], scanned, truncated }

actions.name: tag.list
actions.summary: All #tags used in a notebook with counts.

actions.name: note.image
actions.summary: The image of an image excerpt, or of a handwriting/image comment, as base64.

commentIndex.desc: Index of a PaintNote comment; omit for the excerpt image.

actions.name: review.status
actions.summary: Whether a note is currently in a review deck.

actions.name: note.create
actions.summary: Create a card as a child of parentId (or as a root of notebookId), with optional excerpt, comments, tags and color.

parentId.desc: Parent note. Either parentId or notebookId is required.

notebookId.desc: Create a root note in this notebook.

beforeId.desc: Insert before this sibling instead of appending.

comments.desc: Comments to append: "markdown text" or {text, markdown} or {linkTo: noteId} or {html, text}.

title.desc: Card title (plain text, not rendered as Markdown).

excerpt.desc: Card body / excerpt text. Rendered as Markdown + LaTeX when markdown=true.

markdown.desc: Render the excerpt as Markdown (default true when excerpt is given on create).

actions.returns: note detail of the new card

actions.name: note.update
actions.summary: Change title, excerpt, Markdown flag, color or fill of a card. Omitted fields stay unchanged.

title.desc: Card title (plain text, not rendered as Markdown).

excerpt.desc: Card body / excerpt text. Rendered as Markdown + LaTeX when markdown=true.

markdown.desc: Render the excerpt as Markdown (default true when excerpt is given on create).

actions.name: note.delete
actions.summary: Delete a card. Refuses when it has children unless recursive=true.

actions.name: note.move
actions.summary: Move a card (with its subtree) under another parent, before a sibling, or out to the notebook root.

parentId.desc: New parent. Omit with toRoot=true to detach to the root.

beforeId.desc: Place before this child of the new parent.

actions.name: note.clone
actions.summary: Copy a card (MarginNote clone) into a notebook, optionally under a parent.

parentId.desc: Place the copy under this note.

actions.name: note.link
actions.summary: Add a note link (marginnote4app://note/…) from one card to another, optionally both ways.

actions.name: comment.add
actions.summary: Append a comment: Markdown (default, supports LaTeX), plain text, HTML, or a link to another note.

linkTo.desc: Note id to link instead of text.

actions.name: comment.remove
actions.summary: Remove the comment at an index (see note.get for indices).

actions.name: comment.update
actions.summary: Replace the text of a text/Markdown comment, keeping its position.

actions.name: comment.reorder
actions.summary: Reorder comments. order lists current indices in the new order, e.g. [2,0,1].

actions.name: tag.add
actions.summary: Add #tags to a card (stored the MarginNote way, as a "#a #b" comment).

actions.name: tag.remove
actions.summary: Remove #tags from a card.

actions.name: note.importMarkdown
actions.summary: Turn a Markdown outline (# headings and nested lists) into a card tree under parentId or at the notebook root.

mode.desc: title: heading→title, body→excerpt. excerpt: heading+body→excerpt (no title). comment: heading→title, body→Markdown comment.

color.desc: Color index for every created card.

actions.returns: { created: count, tree: [{ id, title, children }] }

actions.name: batch
actions.summary: Run many actions in one round trip and ONE undo step. Later ops can reference earlier results with "$<index>.<field>", e.g. {"parentId": "$0.id"}. With atomic=true (default) a failure rolls everything back.

notebookId.desc: Notebook that receives the single undo step.

actions.returns: { results: [data], completed } or error with details.failedIndex
